usage: Adapted nogds_file_reader state, constructor, submit/wait methods and destructor. Standard pread workers and two pinned buffers/streams per worker. Framework operations injected; no Python, GDS, io_uring, libaio, dlopen or NUMA dependency. Buffered fallback additionally accepts EPERM/EOPNOTSUPP. ABI wrapper and bounded tensor staging are local.
modifications: Extract the non-GDS worker reader into a private C++ namespace and minimal header.
Inject CPU/CUDA runtime operations from LibTorch; remove Python, dynamic loading, NUMA and global memory counters.
Retain the two-buffer per-worker read/upload pipeline and drain semantics.
Also fall back to buffered reads on EPERM/EOPNOTSUPP and remove ignored const return qualifiers.
The local wrapper validates Rust-provided ranges, reads bounded chunks, owns each tensor allocation, converts large tensors in bounded pieces, and drains CUDA copies before returning.
